posts.title: Why, oh why… – …is it so hard to buy a digital bus ticket in 2026?
posts.description: Paying digitally for public transportation in my hometown Munich is swift and convenient. In theory. You open the app, swipe right, hop on a bus, ride, hop off, swipe left – done. The app handles fare zones for you, and no matter how often you ride that day, you are never charged more than what a day ticket would cost. Sounds lovely, doesn’t it? posts.title: Timer – Programmable timer web app – e.g. for gym workouts or stretching sessions
posts.description: I have a mild habit of building my own version of things that surely already exist. This time it’s a timer web app – one that counts down, beeps, and reads activity names out loud. The main use-case is workout or stretching sessions that consist of repeatable sequences, e.g. where you are holding certain positions for a set time.
